description: "Never invent versions, benchmarks, links, features or quotes while writing."

# No invented facts

Applies to all writing, in any file or reply.

- Never make up version numbers, release dates, benchmarks, statistics, user counts, quotes, testimonials or links.
- Never claim a feature, integration or platform is supported unless you saw it in the code, config or docs.
- Never fabricate a licence, author, or attribution. If it is missing, say it is not provided.
- Do not describe test results you did not run or see.
- When unsure, ask the user or write `TODO:` with the open question, and mention it in your final summary.
- Cite the source file for non-obvious claims in your reply so the user can check them.
